jobs.description:
Voor onze relatie in Antwerpen zijn wij dringend op zoek naar een 1e lijns support engineer.
 

 
 

Key Responsibilities
 

 
 

Provide first-line IT support to colleagues worldwide and act as an escalation point for other IT service agents across our global network.
 

Troubleshoot incidents and technical issues involving Microsoft 365, Windows, hardware, networks, servers and internally developed applications.
 

Manage the lifecycle of end-user devices, including installation, configuration, maintenance and replacement.
 

Support IT onboarding by creating user accounts, managing access rights and preparing IT equipment for new colleagues.
 

Register, manage and follow up on incidents and service requests through our ticketing system, ensuring accurate worklogs.
 

Prepare and maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles and end-user instructions.
 

Track and manage IT assets, ensuring accurate inventory records and efficient equipment management.
 

 
 

Your Profile
 

 
 

You hold a Bachelor's degree or graduate diploma in IT, or equivalent qualifications through experience, combined with relevant hands-on experience in IT support.
 

You have a solid understanding of Microsoft 365 and Windows environments. Knowledge of Microsoft Intune, Active Directory, Windows Autopilot, networking or server infrastructure is a plus.
 

You have strong troubleshooting skills and the curiosity to investigate unfamiliar issues independently rather than immediately escalating them.
 

You are communicative, approachable and service-minded, and feel comfortable supporting colleagues both remotely and in person.
 

You are hands-on, take initiative and are eager to further develop your technical expertise towards more advanced IT roles.
 

You enjoy working in an international, multicultural team and adapt easily to changing priorities.
 

You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch is an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Cloud DataOps Platform Engineer - Data & AI
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working on projects, are you a true Microsoft Azure DevOps specialist and do you provide the right Microsoft Cloud Infrastructure solutions for our customers? Do you like to bridge the gap between operations and development? Then Cegeka's rapidly growing and passionate Data & AI team has an interesting challenge for you! We are looking for a Cloud DataOps Platform Engineer, a crucial role in modern data-driven organisations where scalability, reliability and automation are key.

 

• You are a driving force for further developing the DevOps culture within our Data & AI team. This means that you contribute to best practices regarding automation, version control, releases, infrastructure, security, etc. Thanks to your coaching style, you know how to lift other project members to a higher level.
• You build and manage data platforms that run analytics, AI and ML.
• You are responsible for setting up, maintaining and automating cloud environments using IaC tools such as Terraform and Bicep.
• You develop, implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data-related applications in Azure.
• You will automate data pipelines (ETL/ELT).
• You will be responsible for integrating services such as Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.
• You will configure and manage Azure infrastructure for data applications, including Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, Azure SQL Database, and others.
• You will perform quality checks, testing and monitoring of data sets.
• You will oversee cost optimisation, security and monitoring of cloud resources.
• You will respond quickly to operational incidents in the data environment.
• Innovation and knowledge sharing are high on our agenda. We are always looking for innovation and improvement for our customers. You will have plenty of opportunities to actively participate in this.
• Cegeka has partnerships with Microsoft, Databricks and Snowflake.  
• You will join a close, driven and passionate team where it is pleasant and fun to work. We even have our own Data & AI fun team.
What you need to succeed:
• You are an eager to learn and driven Cloud Engineer with several years of professional experience with Azure.
• Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert are a plus.  
• You have experience writing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates or similar.
• You have experience setting up automated CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Github Actions, or similar tools.
• You have strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail.
• Knowledge of basic system administration or experience working with system administrators is a plus.
• You write high-quality, readable code and refactor where necessary. You guarantee quality through test-driven development and continuous learning.
• You have strong communication and teamwork skills.
• Not only is your knowledge important, we consider your motivation, insight and attitude to be just as important. You have a dynamic personality and are eager to learn.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English.

Do you combine deep Microsoft security expertise with architectural judgement to turn complex requirements into secure, scalable and supportable solutions? As Security Solution Architect – Microsoft Security, part of our Security & Networking Architecture team, you are a senior, customer-facing technical authority for the Microsoft security domain. You own solution architecture and design authority from discovery through delivery, translating business, risk and security requirements into integrated architectures across Microsoft 365, Azure and hybrid environments. Your scope spans Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Purview. You collaborate closely with the Cegeka Modern SOC, which supports the Microsoft security stack. You work directly on customer engagements and provide specialist architecture expertise to opportunities led by the Solution Pre-Sales team.

 

• You lead customer discovery, architecture workshops and technical decision forums to assess Microsoft security maturity and clarify requirements, constraints, dependencies and risks.
• Design integrated Zero Trust architectures using Microsoft Entra, Defender, Sentinel and Purview, with Intune and Azure networking controls where relevant.
• Act as design authority for Microsoft security solutions: define high-level designs, integration patterns and security standards; review solution artefacts; and govern exceptions, technical debt and architectural trade-offs.
• Guide engineering and project teams through implementation and migration. Validate detailed designs, configuration baselines and runbooks. Agree onboarding and acceptance criteria with the Cegeka Modern SOC, including detection and response workflows, access and escalation paths, and confirm readiness for operational handover.
• Address security, integration and operational risks through least privilege, identity governance, segmentation, data protection and resilience. Define telemetry, automation and integration requirements with the Cegeka Modern SOC across Microsoft and third-party platforms, with clear ownership of control management and incident response.
• Provide validated Microsoft security architecture inputs to the Solution Pre-Sales team, including solution options, licensing prerequisites, consumption and delivery estimates, assumptions, dependencies and risks.
• Partner with Product Management and the Cegeka Modern SOC to evolve Microsoft security services, reference architectures, blueprints and costing models. Use operational feedback and incident lessons to improve designs and translate platform developments into supportable customer propositions.
• Maintain reusable Microsoft security architecture assets, coach colleagues and contribute to Microsoft technology-partner relationships. Evaluate emerging capabilities, including AI security, against customer needs and operational constraints.
What you need to succeed:
• Substantial experience designing and delivering enterprise Microsoft security solutions, with senior-level architectural credibility and the ability to lead customer-facing technical discussions.
• Deep hands-on expertise in at least one Microsoft security pillar—Entra identity and access, Defender threat protection, Sentinel security operations, Defender for Cloud, or Purview data security—with architectural understanding across the wider portfolio.
• Strong understanding of Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoint management with Intune, networking and workload security, including integration with non-Microsoft technologies.
• Experience collaborating with SOC and managed services teams on monitoring, response, onboarding and operational handover.
• Demonstrated ability to translate requirements into integrated high-level designs, govern technical decisions and review detailed designs, migration plans, security baselines and operational documentation. Practical familiarity with KQL, PowerShell or infrastructure-as-code is an asset.
• Experience supporting dedicated presales teams with Microsoft security solution options, licensing and consumption considerations, effort and cost inputs, dependencies and risks.
• You can explain technical trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
• Strong architectural thinking, technical leadership, consulting, communication and collaboration skills. You balance Microsoft platform capabilities with customer risk, existing investments, commercial constraints and supportability.
• Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are an asset.
• Microsoft security certifications or equivalent demonstrable expertise.
• Relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, infrastructure or architecture.

Change Manager - Facilities Transformation
We are looking for a medior change Manager to support the launch of a Facilities transformation programme covering activities across both headquarters and branches. The scope is broad and includes areas such as building maintenance, procurement and sales. You do not need to be a Facilities or building-sector expert; the key is to understand the context quickly and help people make sense of what is changing.

Working closely with the Head of Change & Transformation, Facilities project managers and key stakeholders, you will help challenge, structure and deliver the change approach. You will contribute to important programme milestones and support teams in understanding how Facilities activities operate today and how they may evolve in the future.

Your responsibilities will include preparing and facilitating presentations and workshops, contributing to training materials and communications, and helping draft content for works councils. You will map current ways of working (As Is) and support the design of future processes and ways of working (To Be), particularly for major transformation initiatives. You will also help make complex or technical topics clear, accessible and relevant to different audiences.

The role involves working with teams across four Facilities subdomains, representing around 200 people. Process-mapping and future-state discussions will mainly be held with a smaller group of approximately four to six key stakeholders. You will facilitate these discussions, gather relevant insights and help translate them into a clear view of the future journey and operating model. Depending on programme needs, you may also contribute to the preparation of an RFP.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable facilitating groups, structuring ideas and communicating with a range of stakeholders. You should be able to get up to speed quickly in a new environment, take a practical and collaborative approach, and explain change in straightforward terms. Experience in change management, workshop facilitation and process mapping is important. This could suit someone who is keen to build their experience in change management and appreciates working in a supportive, well-guided team.

Fluency in French or Dutch is required, together with a good understanding of the other national language. Good written English is also needed, particularly for preparing emails and presentations. Specific experience in Facilities, buildings or maintenance is not required.

Responsibilities

• Lead the technical development of business components for a pension application using modern frameworks.
• Design, develop, and maintain applications using C# and .NET Core.
• Translate functional requirements into technical specifications and validate them with business stakeholders.
• Analyze and resolve complex technical issues and provide second-level support to the team.
• Implement automation and continuous integration through pipelines and unit testing to ensure stability.
• Collaborate within an agile team following the SAFe framework to deliver iterative software increments.
• Produce and review technical documentation while mentoring other developers on the project.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in backend development with C# and .NET Core.
• 3+ years of experience with frontend development using Blazor.
• 3+ years of experience with Entity Framework and gRPC.
• 3+ years of experience with CI/CD and Azure DevOps.
• 3+ years of experience in Agile and Scrum methodologies.
• Proven experience with WPF and WCF.
• Experience with Python.
• Excellent analytical skills and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with passive knowledge of the other language and understanding of English.
Nice to Haves

• Willingness to work in a SAFe environment.

A packed schedule, a hundred things happening at once and always something that needs sorting out. Sound familiar?
  
Some people find that stressful. You actually thrive on it!
  
As Management & Personal Assistant, you'll become a trusted right hand to management, providing both professional and personal support.
  
But here's what really makes the difference: you don't just get things started, you make sure they're properly taken care of, right down to the smallest detail. 
  
You'll be trusted to take ownership, anticipate needs and find solutions independently, without constant reminders or follow-ups.
  
The goal? To give management the peace of mind that when something is in your hands, it's taken care of.
  
No two days are quite the same. And that's exactly what makes this role so interesting!
  
Your responsibilities cover two main areas.
  
Management Support – Making things happen behind the scenes
    
• You manage inboxes, calendars and daily communications, ensuring everything is followed up efficiently.  
• You organise and prepare meetings, appointments and discussions.  
• You gather information, bring structure and create clear, practical overviews.  
• You keep track of deadlines, action points and ongoing projects.  
• You provide administrative and organisational support across various management responsibilities, including sales and HR.  
• You liaise with colleagues, suppliers and external partners.  
• You assist with the practical organisation of business trips, trade fairs, reservations and events.  
• When management is away, you keep things moving. You follow up on important matters, handle what you can independently and provide a clear overview upon their return.   
Personal & Household Management – Making life easier!
  
Beyond business support, you'll also help keep the personal lives of the management team running smoothly.
  
This isn't a housekeeping position. It's about coordinating, organising and taking care of practical matters that make everyday life easier.
    
• You coordinate external household help and manage the related planning and communication.  
• You arrange home maintenance, repairs, deliveries and appointments.  
• You handle practical errands and purchases for both the company and private needs.  
• You manage orders, parcels, deliveries and returns.  
• You organise gifts, flowers and thoughtful gestures.  
• You research and coordinate private travel, appointments and reservations.  
• You take care of practical arrangements involving vehicles, servicing and other everyday matters.   
And sometimes, something unexpected simply needs sorting out.
  
No problem. You focus on solutions, not obstacles!

An impressive CV? Great! But for this position, who you are and how you work matter just as much as what you've already accomplished.
  
We're looking for someone who's naturally organised. Not because they've learned to be, but because it's simply part of who they are. Someone who notices the little things, thinks ahead and genuinely enjoys bringing order to a busy day.
  
Does this sound like you?
    
• Organisation is second nature to you. You love structure, have an exceptional eye for detail and never lose sight of the bigger picture.  
• You're always thinking a few steps ahead. You spot what needs doing, take initiative and don't wait for instructions.  
• You take real ownership. When something is entrusted to you, others can count on it being handled from start to finish, without having to double-check.  
• Discretion comes naturally. You're trustworthy, reliable and understand the importance of confidentiality when professional and personal matters overlap.  
• You're hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented. You switch easily between different responsibilities and stay calm when unexpected situations arise.  
• You're a confident communicator and digitally savvy. You communicate clearly, feel comfortable with digital tools and adapt easily to different situations.  
• You genuinely enjoy making life easier for others. Knowing that someone can stop worrying about something because you've taken care of it? That's what motivates you!   
What else do you bring?
    
• A bachelor's degree and ideally some initial experience in an administrative, organisational or support role.

jobs.description:
• Provide organisational and administrative support to the Brussels team, working closely with the Executive Management Assistant  
• Assist with planning business trips, including travel expense claims  
• Help plan and organise internal and external meetings and events  
• Handle professional correspondence with the member companies, political institutions, public authorities and other stakeholders, and assist with preparing and sending mail merges  
• Manage shared mailboxes and coordinate appointments, deadlines and outstanding tasks  
• Assist with preparing and updating documents, presentations and position papers, including final quality checks  
• Coordinate the monthly eu-flash newsletter and help maintain the website and other information materials  
• Coordinate with internal and external service providers (e.g. IT and suppliers), check invoices and prepare cost summaries  
• Assist with onboarding new employees and interns 
  
• Completed vocational training as a foreign-language secretary or a comparable qualification involving foreign languages, plus several years of experience in an assistant role, ideally in an association, a political institution or a similar environment  
• Professional, courteous communication skills, with the ability to adapt to different audiences  
• Native-level proficiency in German, fluency in English and a good command of French are required  
• Confident and proficient use of MS Office, particularly SharePoint, Teams, PowerPoint and Word  
• Strong organisational and planning skills, with sound judgement in setting priorities, managing deadlines and coordinating multiple tasks  
• An independent, structured approach to work, the ability to work as part of a team, a high level of commitment and dedication, and a strong service orientation

A packed schedule, a hundred things happening at once and always something that needs sorting out. Sound familiar?
  
Some people find that stressful. You actually thrive on it!
  
As Management & Personal Assistant, you'll become a trusted right hand to management, providing both professional and personal support.
  
But here's what really makes the difference: you don't just get things started, you make sure they're properly taken care of, right down to the smallest detail. 
  
You'll be trusted to take ownership, anticipate needs and find solutions independently, without constant reminders or follow-ups.
  
The goal? To give management the peace of mind that when something is in your hands, it's taken care of.
  
No two days are quite the same. And that's exactly what makes this role so interesting!
  
Your responsibilities cover two main areas.
  
Management Support – Making things happen behind the scenes
    
• You manage inboxes, calendars and daily communications, ensuring everything is followed up efficiently.  
• You organise and prepare meetings, appointments and discussions.  
• You gather information, bring structure and create clear, practical overviews.  
• You keep track of deadlines, action points and ongoing projects.  
• You provide administrative and organisational support across various management responsibilities, including sales and HR.  
• You liaise with colleagues, suppliers and external partners.  
• You assist with the practical organisation of business trips, trade fairs, reservations and events.  
• When management is away, you keep things moving. You follow up on important matters, handle what you can independently and provide a clear overview upon their return.   
Personal & Household Management – Making life easier!
  
Beyond business support, you'll also help keep the personal lives of the management team running smoothly.
  
This isn't a housekeeping position. It's about coordinating, organising and taking care of practical matters that make everyday life easier.
    
• You coordinate external household help and manage the related planning and communication.  
• You arrange home maintenance, repairs, deliveries and appointments.  
• You handle practical errands and purchases for both the company and private needs.  
• You manage orders, parcels, deliveries and returns.  
• You organise gifts, flowers and thoughtful gestures.  
• You research and coordinate private travel, appointments and reservations.  
• You take care of practical arrangements involving vehicles, servicing and other everyday matters.   
And sometimes, something unexpected simply needs sorting out.
  
No problem. You focus on solutions, not obstacles!

An impressive CV? Great! But for this position, who you are and how you work matter just as much as what you've already accomplished.
  
We're looking for someone who's naturally organised. Not because they've learned to be, but because it's simply part of who they are. Someone who notices the little things, thinks ahead and genuinely enjoys bringing order to a busy day.
  
Does this sound like you?
    
• Organisation is second nature to you. You love structure, have an exceptional eye for detail and never lose sight of the bigger picture.  
• You're always thinking a few steps ahead. You spot what needs doing, take initiative and don't wait for instructions.  
• You take real ownership. When something is entrusted to you, others can count on it being handled from start to finish, without having to double-check.  
• Discretion comes naturally. You're trustworthy, reliable and understand the importance of confidentiality when professional and personal matters overlap.  
• You're hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented. You switch easily between different responsibilities and stay calm when unexpected situations arise.  
• You're a confident communicator and digitally savvy. You communicate clearly, feel comfortable with digital tools and adapt easily to different situations.  
• You genuinely enjoy making life easier for others. Knowing that someone can stop worrying about something because you've taken care of it? That's what motivates you!   
What else do you bring?
    
• A bachelor's degree and ideally some initial experience in an administrative, organisational or support role.  
• Previous experience in a similar position is a definite advantage, but the right attitude, maturity and potential to grow into the role are just as valuable.  
• Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken, ideally together with good written French.  
• A valid category B driving licence.   
And the right personal fit? That's just as important to us.
  
You feel at home in a dynamic, informal environment with a relatively young team. You're positive, engaged and bring a healthy dose of common sense.
  
Ultimately, we're looking for someone management can turn to and say: "Could you take care of this?" And know it's in good hands.
